# More Features | DougSpeed.com

## Overview

This page serves as a directory for additional LDAK features and functionalities beyond the main analysis categories.

## Features Listed

- **Adjust Kinships** – Used for HE or PCGC Regression with covariates
- **Calculate Scores** – Fits and tests prediction models
- **Calculate Statistics** – Obtains allele frequencies and missingness rates
- **Filter Relatedness** – Removes familial relatedness prior to heritability estimation
- **Jackknife** – Computes prediction model accuracy
- **Make Data** – Converts, merges, or reduces genetic data files
- **Manipulate Kinships** – Adds or subtracts kinship matrices
- **Principal Components** – Identifies structure in genetic data
- **Pseudo Summaries** – Enables cross-validation without individual-level data
- **Simulate Data** – Generates genotypes and phenotypes
- **TetraHer and QuantHer** – Estimates family heritability (particularly for diseases)
- **Thin Predictors** – Filters predictors based on linkage disequilibrium
